about: Words an owner's screen never shows (build specification section 4, rule 6; M3.DS.01 AC 4). Business language only: the source of a figure is a labelled field such as Source: Trade sheet, 01 Oct 2026. Read by the design system's kit copy lint and, vendored by npm run design-system:sync, by the One Link web copy test. Change it here, then sync.

m5.about: The M5 banned-word list, the epic's single list (M5.DS.01 AC 6, shared with M5.ALR.02 and M5.CC.01): words the Managing Director's path never shows in text or accessible labels (Home and its drill-downs, the daily summary, the end-of-day report, the Assistant and his approvals). Internal reference patterns are banned too: goods received note, delivery note, loading order and weighbridge numbers. Allowed identifiers: contract references (SYN4702), truck registrations and counterparty names. glossary holds the left column of the S57 glossary that names an invented concept; generic words the map itself uses on screen (Stock, Journey, Absent) are left out of it.
